column1: # These apply to a user's personal team
# ACCOUNT ADMIN - Full personal team management
# EVENT MANAGER - Manage events and attendees in personal team
# TEAM MEMBER - View-only access in personal team
# These apply to an institution team
# ACCOUNT ADMIN - Full institution team management
# EVENT MANAGER - Manage events and attendees in institution team
# TEAM MEMBER - View-only access in institution team
# Guest - Public event viewing only (no domain restriction)
